title: Stackup Opens Platform to All: Transform Your Business Operations on Blockchain
summary: Stackup opens general availability to all businesses operating on blockchains. Learn how to create your free account here!
body_markdown:
Every day, billion-dollar crypto companies face a hard choice: trust their treasury to expensive enterprise platforms that restrict what they can do, or risk everything with consumer-grade hardware wallets. Neither option delivers what businesses actually need—the freedom to operate on blockchain with enterprise-grade security and controls.


Today, that changes. We're opening Stackup to everyone.


After powering operations for some of crypto's largest companies, we've built something transformative: a platform that brings traditional financial controls to blockchain operations, without sacrificing what makes blockchain powerful.


Here's what that means for your business:


## True Control Without Complexity


- Replace hardware wallets with passkey-based security that works across any device
- Set up role-based permissions that work across all chains
- Create approval workflows that match how your business actually operates
- Full portability of your operations—no vendor lock-in


## Automated Operations That Scale


- Schedule payments to happen automatically
- No gas fees, no need to hold native tokens across all chains
- Approve transactions by email
- Track every transaction in real time


## Enterprise-Grade Security Made Simple


- Non-custodial control of all assets
- No hardware devices, MPC networks, or browser extensions needed
- Specific access for team members without risking your entire wallet


## Pricing That Scales With You


Get started for free and only pay for what you use. No subscriptions, no complex tiers. This means you can:


- Set up your entire team at no cost
- Test our full feature set without commitment
- Scale spending as your operations grow


We built Stackup because we believe running a business on blockchain shouldn't be harder than traditional finance. Now, it isn't.


Ready to transform your onchain operations?[Sign up for free now](https://app.stackup.fi/register)
